description: This file defines data structures, constants, and functions related to push notifications in the Mattermost server, including notification types, server URLs, acknowledgment and notification data models, and utility methods.

classes.name: PushNotificationAck
classes.description: Represents acknowledgment information for a push notification, including ID, timestamp, platform, type, post ID, and load status.

classes.name: PushNotification
classes.description: Represents a push notification with various metadata such as device info, message content, badge, sound, sender info, and related identifiers.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the PushNotification instance.

methods.name: SetDeviceIdAndPlatform
methods.description: Parses a device ID string to set the platform and device ID fields in the PushNotification.
